summary: American psychologist turned TV host Phil McGraw built a fortune on self-help seminars and daytime television, cheating business partners and exploiting addicts and troubled teens on air for ratings.

evidence.note: birth in 1950 in Oklahoma, childhood in Texas oil fields
doctorate in 1979, private practice with his father for wealthy clients
meets Thelma Box and launches the Pathways motivational seminars
secretly sells his Pathways stake, cutting out Box
dual relationship with a patient leads to a psychology board sanction
jury consulting firm CSI and the Oprah beef trial in Amarillo
Dr. Phil show starts 2002; on-air remarks about a nine-year-old
VR addiction program sold to rehab centers for free on-air endorsements
Inspirations for Youth and Families and its runaway teens
addicted guests allegedly given alcohol or left to buy heroin before taping
Bregoli sent to Turnabout Ranch; abuse allegations at the ranch
spinoff The Doctors from 2008 and a 2014 study of its advice

notes: The host repeatedly calls Wichita Falls part of Kansas; it is in Texas. The year he met Box is garbled in the transcript (likely 1984); main_span starts there and is marked approximate. Texas and California both matter, so no subdivision. Primary theme could also be wellness-self-help; chose entertainment-celebrity because part 2 centres on exploitative talk TV. Football section (about 5 minutes) left out of themes.
